as_of_note: Orders taper off after Aug 2018, so the home page treats the week ending Aug 19, 2018 as the latest complete week.

agg_orders_daily.description: Orders rolled up by day, customer state and status. Additive counts and sums.

agg_items_daily.description: Order items rolled up by day, product category, seller state and customer state (canceled and unavailable orders excluded).

fct_orders.description: Raw fact table, used for distinct counts.

fct_order_items.description: Raw fact table, used for distinct counts.

metrics.name: gmv
metrics.label: GMV
metrics.description: Gross merchandise value in BRL: item prices excluding freight, canceled and unavailable orders excluded.

metrics.name: orders
metrics.label: Orders
metrics.description: Orders placed, excluding canceled and unavailable.

metrics.name: new_customers
metrics.label: New customers
metrics.description: People placing their first valid order.

metrics.name: late_delivery_rate
metrics.label: Late delivery rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered orders that arrived more than a day after the promised date.

metrics.name: avg_delivery_days
metrics.label: Days to deliver
metrics.description: Average days from purchase to delivery, delivered orders only.

metrics.name: avg_review_score
metrics.label: Review score
metrics.description: Average review score (1 to 5) of reviewed orders, by purchase date.

metrics.name: cancel_rate
metrics.label: Cancel rate
metrics.description: Share of orders canceled or unavailable.

metrics.name: freight_ratio
metrics.label: Freight / GMV
metrics.description: Freight charged as a share of GMV.

metrics.name: category_gmv
metrics.label: Item GMV
metrics.description: Item prices in BRL; use this (not gmv) when grouping by product_category or seller_state.

metrics.name: active_customers
metrics.label: Active customers
metrics.sql: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable'))
metrics.description: Distinct people with a valid order in the period. Not additive across periods.

metrics.name: active_sellers
metrics.label: Active sellers
metrics.sql: COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable'))
metrics.description: Distinct sellers with a valid item sold in the period.
